lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p34 - Talk about the pictures.

details: Talk about the pictures activates vocabulary recall. Students identify the transport modes and numbers in the review section to ensure they can name them before the listening task.
Look for accurate naming of the vehicles (Taxi, Train, Boat, Bus, Walking, Bike) and correct reading of the numbers (21, 12, 18) when prompted.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p34 - Listen and tick.

details: Listen and tick assesses auditory comprehension. Students listen to the audio descriptions and select the correct image by ticking the box.
Look for attentive listening and marking the correct box corresponding to the audio cue (e.g., ticking the boat, or the number 12).

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p34 - Ask and answer with How do you go to school?

details: Ask and answer assesses speaking fluency and grammar application. Students interview a partner using the target question and reply with their personal mode of transport.
Look for clear pronunciation of the question and the response "I go by [bus/car]" or "I walk."
